name: components_g4_fancurve
source:
// FanCurve: the enthalpy-free fan quadratic dP = dP0*(1 - (Q/Q0)^2) at a
// fixed density. Q = 1.5 of Q0 = 3 m^3/s puts it mid-curve: dP = 300 Pa.
FanCurve FC(f1, f2, rho = 1.2, dP0 = 400, Q0 = 3.0)

f1.P    = 101325
f1.mdot = 1.8
dp_fan  = f2.P - f1.P
m_out   = f2.mdot
